4 · Training vs validation loss (log-space RMSE), early stopping marked

Clean side-by-side — full curve (left) and zoom of the last 400 rounds (right, ±0.01 y-window): validation rides above training until ~iteration 700, then the curves cross and training keeps dipping — which is why early stopping fires at iteration 798 (val log-RMSE 0.4129, train 0.4117, gap ≈ 0.0012).
